notes: A real click on the button (600 ms after navigation) inserts a 180px table above the text. The text moves 196px and Chromium does report a layout-shift entry, but with hadRecentInput: true, because it happens within 500 ms of the input. Such entries are excluded from CLS and must not be reported as a problem. "interactions" in this file tells the validator to click; "minEntriesWithRecentInput" makes sure the excused entry really occurs.
